==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am at a party. The party seems to be a celebration of someone's birthday who has already had a birthday party earlier this year. They say that this is their "Bonus Birthday".

Two women with brown bowl cut haircuts and brown eyes are at the party. One is dressed like a cave woman wearing a bikini made of brown fur. The other is wearing a tattered green plaid shirt and a long brown fur kilt.

The women seem to be warriors who have come to arrest someone at the party. I start to suspect that the two women might be time traveling police officers. I wake up before I can find out who they were after.
